item.title: New Technology Days: Multi-Year Innovation Festival (2019–2026)
item.author: klim.milosz@gmail.com (Miłosz Klim)
item.description: Co-organizing every edition of New Technology Days: hands-on hardware workshops, 3D printing labs, Unity demos, and connecting high schoolers with university research.

item.title: Where It All Started - Anthropological Reconstruction & 3D Printing
item.author: klim.milosz@gmail.com (Miłosz Klim)
item.description: An interdisciplinary scientific project reconstructing the skulls of early inhabitants of Greater Poland using FDM 3D printing, cutting production costs 15-fold, presented at Poznań City Hall.
